name: senderos
description: Command-line interface for the Senderos engineering orchestration platform.

scripts.build: bun run clean && bun build ./src/index.ts --target=bun --outfile=./dist/index.js --external '@libsql/*' --external 'drizzle-orm/*' && cp -R ../core/drizzle ./dist/drizzle && cp -R ../core/src/bootstrap/agents ./dist/agents && cp -R ../core/src/bootstrap/senderos ./dist/senderos
scripts.coverage: bun test --isolate --coverage --coverage-reporter=lcov --coverage-reporter=text --coverage-dir coverage && bun run src/scripts/check-coverage.ts
scripts.release:check: bun run typecheck && bun run coverage && bun run build && bun run package:check
